description.text: Period of Study 3 or 4 years; starts in September. Application Period March 1st, 2011 to May 20th , 2011

duration.text: The Tourism Administration at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 305 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.Photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 7.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8.Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here.

requirements.text: 1. (Applicants should be between the) age of 18 to 45 2.Master's degree or equivalent or above. 3.New HSK Level 8 4.Be in good health and foreigners
